args.body:
• Juniper Labware newsletter: covers warehouse automation in 2026, linking to their article at blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse.
• Article: pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse Automation 2026
